full_name: Jessica Vaughn | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2024–2025 Arts David and Roberta Logie Fellow Temple University
bio: Jessica Vaughn is a visual artist consumed by what others perceive as arbitrary, oftentimes going to sculptural lengths concerned with traditions of minimalism and conceptual art to encourage closer inspection of the systems that dictate where which bodies go and by what means.
